name: Efficiency Metrics Calculation
summary: Calculate score-per-watt and score-per-dollar efficiency metrics for a benchmark result
purpose: Calculate score-per-watt and score-per-dollar efficiency metrics for a benchmark result. Verify inputs and show formulas.
assignment_instructions: You are calculating efficiency metrics for a benchmark result. REQUIRED OUTPUT: Return a JSON object with these exact fields: - assignment_id (string): use "compute_efficiency_metrics_v1" - agent_summary (string) - inputs_used (list of strings) - missing_inputs (list of strings) - claims (list of objects): claim, evidence_reference, confidence ("provided"|"inferred"|"missing") - calculations (list of objects): name, formula, inputs, result, units, assumptions - risks (list of objects): risk, severity ("low"|"medium"|"high"), evidence_reference - assumptions (list of strings) - open_questions (list of strings) - final_output (string) - self_check (object): all_required_sections_completed (boolean), all_numbers_have_sources (boolean), assumptions_labeled (boolean), missing_inputs_disclosed (boolean) Also include: - benchmark_name (string) - gpu_model (string) - benchmark_score (number) - score_units (string) - avg_power_w (number): average power draw during benchmark - gpu_cost_usd (number): acquisition cost of GPU in USD - score_per_watt (number or null): benchmark_score / avg_power_w, null if avg_power_w is 0 - score_per_watt_units (string): "{score_units}/W" - score_per_dollar (number or null): benchmark_score / gpu_cost_usd, null if gpu_cost_usd is 0 - score_per_dollar_units (string): "{score_units}/USD" - cost_valid (boolean): gpu_cost_usd > 0 - power_valid (boolean): avg_power_w > 0 - both_metrics_computed (boolean): score_per_watt is not null and score_per_dollar is not null Compute score_per_watt as benchmark_score / avg_power_w. Compute score_per_dollar as benchmark_score / gpu_cost_usd. If avg_power_w is 0 or missing, set score_per_watt to null. If gpu_cost_usd is 0 or missing, set score_per_dollar to null. Return numeric values as numbers, not prose. Include both formulas in the calculations array with exact inputs. Use only the provided evidence unless explicitly allowed to assume; label every assumption; if a required input is missing, say so; do not fabricate facts or cite evidence that was not provided.
